name: EP300 lysine acetyltransferase

function.text: EP300 encodes the p300 transcriptional coactivator and acetyltransferase, which regulates transcription through histone acetylation and interactions with transcription factors.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to Rubinstein-Taybi syndrome due to EP300 haploinsufficiency (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include CNS tumor with BCOR/BCORL1 fusion; Biphasic hyalinizing psammomatous / NF2-inactivated renal cell carcinoma. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal dominant; definitive GenCC assertion from ClinGen. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.

function.text: EP300 encodes the p300 transcriptional coactivator and acetyltransferase, which regulates transcription through histone acetylation and interactions with transcription factors. Based in part on similarity, it acts as a histone acetyltransferase and regulates transcription via chromatin remodeling. It acetylates all four core histones in nucleosomes. It is a histone acetylation gives an epigenetic tag for transcriptional activation.

germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with Rubinstein-Taybi syndrome due to EP300 haploinsufficiency (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving EP300 have been reported in CNS tumor with BCOR/BCORL1 fusion, biphasic hyalinizing psammomatous / NF2-inactivated renal cell carcinoma, and angiosarcoma.
